description: A Kotlin class implementing a repository pattern for accessing recipe and category data, interfacing with a local database.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: A singleton class providing high-level CRUD and query operations for recipes and categories, interfacing with local data sources.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all recipes as a Flow list.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes based on the query string.

methods.name: favorites
methods.description: Returns favorite recipes as a Flow list.

methods.name: byCategory
methods.description: Returns recipes belonging to the specified category.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories as a Flow list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite flag for a recipe by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a recipe by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of RecipeRepository.
